# Trippy Tour Guide

> > Self-guided GPS audio walking and driving tours across Europe and Australia, featuring cultural landmarks, historical sites, and themed experiences.

Trippy Tour Guide offers offline GPS-enabled audio tours for independent travelers exploring cities like Paris, Lyon, Nice, Marseille, London, and Australian destinations. Tours cover diverse themes from Vincent Van Gogh's artistic legacy in Arles and Saint-Rémy-de-Provence to Christmas markets, WWII history, and UNESCO World Heritage sites.

## France Walking Tours

- [Lyon Self Guided Walking Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/recorrido-a-pie-autoguiado-por-lyon): Lyon city walking tour starting from Place Bellecour, France
- [Lyon WWII And Resistance Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/lyon-wwii-and-resistance-tour): WWII resistance history tour in Lyon featuring Montluc Prison, France
- [Old Nice Self-Guided Walking Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/old-nice-self-guided-walking-tour): Old Nice markets and historic squares walking tour, France
- [Bordeaux Self-Guided Walking Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/visita-autoguiada-a-pie-por-burdeos): Wine heritage and historic squares walking tour in Bordeaux, France
- [Vieux Lille Self-Guided Walking Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/vieux-lille-recorrido-a-pie-autoguiado): Old Town Lille walking tour exploring historic charm and culture, France
- [Lille UNESCO Sites Self-Guided Walking Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/recorrido-a-pie-autoguiado-por-los-sitios-de-la-unesco-de-lille): Self-guided tour of UNESCO World Heritage sites in Lille, France
- [Arles Vincent Van Gogh Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/rundgang-durch-arles-vincent-van-gogh): Van Gogh art history tour through Arles including Alyscamps, France

## European City Tours

- [London Beatles Legacy Self-Guided Walking Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/visite-a-pied-autoguidee-de-lheritage-des-beatles-a-londres): Beatles landmarks tour in London featuring Abbey Road and music history
- [Munich's Self-Guided Walking Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/muenchens-altstadt-selbstgefuehrter-rundgang): Old Town Munich walking tour from Sendlinger Tor to Marienplatz, Germany
- [Bruges Christmas Market Self Guided Walking Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/ruta-autoguiada-a-pie-del-mercado-navideno-de-brujas): Bruges Christmas market and Winter Glow Festival walking tour, Belgium

## Australia Walking Tours

- [Melbourne City Magic Self Guided Walking Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/melbourne-city-magic-selbstgefuehrte-wandertour): Melbourne city laneways and landmarks walking tour, Australia
- [Cairns City Self Guided Walking Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/cairns-city-selbstgefuehrte-wandertour): GPS audio walking tour of Cairns City landmarks and waterfront, Australia
- [Canberra Culture, Power & History Walking Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/ruta-autoguiada-a-pie-de-canberra-cultura-poder-e-historia): Political landmarks and cultural history tour in Canberra, Australia

## Seasonal & Themed Tours

- [Santa Claus Rovaniemi Self Guided Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/visite-a-pied-autoguidee-du-village-du-pere-noel-a-rovaniemi): Self-guided walking tour of Santa Claus Village in Rovaniemi, Finland
- [Helsinki Christmas Lights Self Guided Walking Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/visite-autoguidee-des-lumieres-de-noel-dhelsinki): Christmas lights and markets walking tour in Helsinki, Finland
- [Tromso Northern Lights self guided Walking Tour](https://trippytourguide.com/st-tour/visite-a-pied-autoguidee-des-aurores-boreales-de-tromso): Arctic city and Northern Lights walking tour in Tromsø, Norway
